rules: If nothing describes what it does, it is Unidentified.

Otherwise, if a machine tried to break it and it held, and it ships a full set of companions (3 or more), it is Set.
Otherwise, if a machine tried to break it and it held, it is Unique.
Otherwise, if it ships a full set of companions (3 or more), it is Rare.

trial.graded: trial.mjs gradeReply: the reply must name exactly one rarity, and it must be the one the rule gives

bar.why: a didy that applies the world's rules for you has to be near-exact: at most three slips in sixty

notMeasured.fledgling: no ~3–4B model is on this machine, and downloading one was not part of this run
notMeasured.larger: sage, elder and titan need more memory than this machine has; the run records the machine and the page computes the floor
notMeasured.tab: the hatchling in a browser tab (WebLLM) is the same size of model; the live page lets anyone run this same trial there, on their own device

sizer.note: the sizer's own starting guess for a classify job, which it calls a heuristic, never a measured score

rules.rule: at least one measured stage names the right rarity for at least 57 of the 60 cards
each larger stage gets at least as many right as the one below it
the hatchling (~1B) falls short of the bar, so this job needs a didy to grow
the smallest stage that clears the bar is not the largest one measured, so growing further would be waste

predictions.said: before any model was asked, by Kar
predictions.hatchling-short: pass — I expect the hatchling around half right; ordered rules with a distracting description are where small models slip
predictions.smaller-suffices: pass — I expect the runner (7B) to clear the bar, so the keeper is not needed; this is the one I am least sure of
predictions.sizer: the sizer starts a classify job at the hatchling; I expect the measurement to overrule it
